title: THE RIVERSIDE APARTMENT
subtitle: Training simulation 01
summary: The scene is secure. Your job is to find, collect, and package every item before it is transported to the laboratory.
objective: Collect every item. Choose packaging that protects each item and the evidence it may hold.

background.alt: An illustrated living room with a sofa, rug, coffee table, window, and doorway

evidence.name: Bloodstained shirt
evidence.alt: A white shirt with a dark red stain
evidence.description: A damp cotton shirt with a dark red stain across the front.
evidence.success: Breathable paper lets moisture escape while protecting the biological stain.
evidence.failure: Trapped moisture encouraged mold and bacterial growth, degrading DNA evidence.

evidence.name: Kitchen knife
evidence.description: A sharp eight-inch kitchen knife near the edge of the rug.
evidence.success: The rigid container immobilizes the blade and protects evidence and handlers.
evidence.failure: The blade punctured its package, creating an injury risk and losing trace material.

evidence.name: Cartridge casing
evidence.description: A small brass casing found beside the coffee table.
evidence.success: The dry casing remains contained and its markings stay protected.
evidence.failure: The selected package did not securely contain this small, dry item.

evidence.name: Hair strand
evidence.description: A single dark strand visible on the pale sofa cushion.
evidence.success: The sealed bag keeps this tiny, dry trace sample from being lost.
evidence.failure: The strand was not securely contained and could be lost during transport.

evidence.name: Mobile phone
evidence.description: A locked phone lying face-up beside the armchair.
evidence.success: The phone remains isolated from loose debris during transport.
evidence.failure: The device was not packaged according to the collection protocol.

evidence.name: Blue fiber
evidence.description: A short blue fiber caught on the coffee table's rough edge.
evidence.success: The small trace sample remains visible, dry, and contained.
evidence.failure: Loose trace evidence could escape or transfer during handling.

evidence.name: Muddy shoe
evidence.description: A dry, mud-caked shoe abandoned close to the doorway.
evidence.success: The dry shoe and its soil evidence remain together for transport.
evidence.failure: Soil flakes may be lost or transferred without secure containment.

evidence.name: Drinking cup
evidence.description: A discarded cup that may hold fingerprints or saliva evidence.
evidence.success: The cup remains isolated for controlled laboratory examination.
evidence.failure: Contact and trace evidence are more vulnerable in this packaging.
